title: [Lean] Bind all 144 selected parsed route tables to certified owners
body:
## Result

At source-matched κ = 836330098538459/500000000000000000 = 0.001672660197076918, this Lean certificate connects all 144 ordered selected route tables’ parsed values to the accepted per-call owner assignment. JSON-byte-to-parsed-value correspondence remains source-reviewed; actual physical charts, private C allocation/operator semantics and executor refinement remain explicit suppliers. It does not prove the full multiplication theorem or change κ.

For every call in Fin144, the strict decoder returns the complete declared table; every one of its Fin704 owner lookups equals the accepted selectedOrdinaryOwner assignment and is injective within that call. All 101,376 ordered family/route rows are covered, including 69,120 helper rows. This supplies parsed-table success and owner binding; it does not equate syntax with physical charts or execution.

## Checked closure and reproduction

The final source 1845c1f7/object 174289ab has independent terminal 16746648. All 26 newly checked roots are accepted with 32 standard-only probes, using the repaired generic bridge rather than its failed preimage. Existing compiler time totals 75.665844489 seconds. The compact completed certificate retains exact source, object, data-review and terminal identities.

This PR includes only 28 new exact Lean sources (745,044 bytes). The remaining 45 sources in the 73-module closure are reconstructed from the already-published all144 owner certificate PR1807 at 457c6c315598ba1a05692fed55e3f47d99dbb184 and unchanged public 0b Stream/Realize inputs. The one Realize import-line adjustment is declared, hashed and inverted; all accepted source bytes remain exact. The README gives the public fetch commands, fresh-output materializer and topological build order for Lean 4.21.0/Mathlib 308445d7. A new relocated replay is not claimed.

## Credit, scope and CI

Credit Rohan Arun's PR1094 overlay, Jeremy Kothe's T16/hyperplane-ended emitter, Hao Yan's retained lineage, columbia-git's PR1553 owner binding, DreamingOfClouds' Stream/Realize and Lean/Mathlib contributors. Full notices and Apache-2.0 are preserved; new proof and packaging used OpenAI assistance. PR1807 is an exact prerequisite, not republished as a new owner certificate.

Current all-state exact-module and proposed-branch searches found no matching PR. Related historical route-table constructions do not provide this exact Lean table-to-owner certificate; this is bounded overlap screening, not a novelty claim. Source JSON/transcription correspondence remains separately reviewed. There is no global cross-call disjointness, complete physical realization or full multiplication theorem claim.

No extra compiler or CI pre-review was run for packaging. Candidate CI will be inspected after submission; generic repository checks alone do not establish a Lean replay. Historical preparation headers and failure evidence remain preserved.
